# ENL Academy Local Skills

These repository-local skills are execution playbooks for common implementation work.

## Available skills

- supabase-schema-rls: Create or evolve schema with tenant-safe RLS.
- invite-onboarding-flow: Implement invite-only auth and profile creation.
- feature-slice-delivery: Deliver one roadmap slice end-to-end.

## How to use

1. Pick one skill that matches your task.
2. Follow the checklist in that skill before opening a PR.
3. Keep scope limited to a single slice unless requested otherwise.
